title: Don Seenu
desc: Inspired by Amitabh Bachchan's Don, a fan sets out to make a name for himself in the underworld. However, a case of mistaken identity may turn this endeavour into a comedy of errors.

title: Arya
desc: Bizarre events compel a gentleman to pursue his authentic identity. Consequently, these unusual anomalies precipitate this earnest quest.

title: Bindaas
desc: Ajay, a young man, sets out to put an end to the conflict between two families that are connected by blood but have been enemies for several years.

title: Rakshasudu
desc: After getting appointed as an inspector, Arun undertakes a mission to track down a notorious serial killer who targets teen girls.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.
